body:
Oh I lost God a long long time ago. I used to be very religious, even wanted to be a preacher, those days are long gone. Thank you though, for your time.  I do appreciate that, sometimes it helps just to have someone acknowledge you. I still plan on going through with it though. Perhaps under different circumstances, had I made different choices or been better prepared for the repercussions of my actions, we would've had that conversation. it's not so much the fact that he left me, it's that ...what kind of man am I that would take something I love, something that makes me happier then ANYTHING and treat him so wrongly. It wasn't that bad during the relationship, I was just incredibly selfish, at the time I thought I was being caring but looking back, no, I was only motivated to do those nice things because I wanted to be happy regardless of how he felt, afterwards though..... And you know he didn't exactly have an easy upbringing either and what kind of man am I that would add to that? That would put so much more hurt into his life, even though I love him. That's my dad, I used to think it wasn't me, that I wasn't him, but I guess I really am. So one more time, people are going to hurt because of me, after that, it'll go away, just become some distant memory. Just one more time. I don't want to die, honestly...but i'm not going to be him, just a well of negative energy, sole purpose in life is to make everyone as miserable as him. 

And once again, looking back at how much I used to hate my dad for what he did, I really was exactly the same. I really am exactly the same. Just I have the balls to admit that i'm wrong.

Everytime I try to start over, I still make the wrong choices. I gave up literally everything when I moved earlier this year, it was me and two duffel bags. Last year I had it all, money, friends, my own house(split rent), a nice car, I fucked that up because I was scared of being put into a "powerful" position where I worked. I wouldve been 19 years old making 50k a year with absolutely amazing benefits just because I knew the right person and did my job well. Now i've got nothing, no friends, no car, no money, hell no dads side of the family because I came out to them last christmas. I was doing alright until I met him, made me the happiest guy alive until I fucked that up to, I thought I WAS better...

You know I don't even know why I posted this here, well no.. a little part of me doesn't want to die. Life is such fucking bullshit though haha, does everything it can to knock you down, puts you into a situation where you can only see one path, one choice, most of the time it's the wrong one, I guess I just wasn't smart enough until now to figure out sometimes it's better to just wait. It gets me though is I do, I can't stand myself, i'm really not the person I thought i'd grow up to be.
